title: Cross-Entropy Logit Gradient
prompt: With a sigmoid output and logit z, the binary cross-entropy gradient simplifies to σ(z) − y. Write σ(z) − y in terms of z and y.
recap:
For a sigmoid output p = σ(z) and binary cross-entropy L = −[y·ln p + (1−y)·ln(1−p)], the gradient w.r.t. the logit z simplifies to dL/dz = σ(z) − y = p − y — the σ′ = σ(1−σ) factors cancel the denominators.

Example — y = 1, z = 0: p = 1/2, so dL/dz = −1/2 (push z up).

This 'predicted minus target' form is why logits are what you backprop. Reference: Goodfellow, Bengio & Courville, Deep Learning, §6.2.
